name: Extra hand plays
author: DecompRecomp
description: Play magic, trap and equip cards freely each turn, and up to five monsters. After a play the hand comes back up; the player may skip the rest with START. The CPU plays its extra cards through its own hand script. Lets another mod hold up to forty cards in hand, ten of them on screen at a time.

settings.label: Monsters per turn
settings.description: How many monsters a turn may put down from the hand; a fusion counts as one. Magic, trap and equip cards are not counted: the hand comes back while it holds one. 1 is the anime's rule.

settings.label: Show skip hint
settings.description: While an extra hand is up for the player, say that START skips it, and when the turn's monsters are spent.
